notes.title: v2.0.1 Update Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "YuuYuu Jiteki no Yuukarin".
The following items have been changed and updated to "v2.0.1".


[h3]Bug fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the attack effect would continue to remain in certain boss battles.
[*] Fixed a typo.
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] When the language is English, the ending that will be reached at the end has been changed to be written in English.
[/list]

[h3]Apology for unfixable problems[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have received multiple reports from everyone that "sometimes we slip through slopes", but the "Pixel Game Maker MV" used in this game production is very unstable in the processing of slopes.
Since this is a software problem, it cannot be fixed here.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but we would appreciate it if you could understand it.
[/list]

Please continue to enjoy "YuuYuu Jiteki no Yuukarin" !!
